ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, in $\triangle ABC$, the perpendicular bisector of AB intersects AC at point D. Given that $BC=10$ and the perimeter of $\triangle BDC$ is $25$, what is the length of AC?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $DE$ is the perpendicular bisector of $AB$,\\
it follows that $DB=DA$,\\
Since the perimeter of $\triangle BDC$ is 25,\\
it follows that $BC+BD+CD=25$,\\
hence $BC+CD+DA=25$,\\
thus $BC+CA=25$,\\
since $BC=10$,\\
it follows that $AC=25-10=\boxed{15}$.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram as triangle ABC with D lying on side AC, E on side AB, line ED crossing AB and AC, and segment BD drawn. From the text, ED is the perpendicular bisector of AB, so any point on ED, in particular D, is equidistant from A and B: DA = DB. Use the text data that the perimeter of triangle BDC is 25 and BC = 10. Write BC + BD + DC = 25, substitute BD = DA, and use the visual fact that D lies on AC so DA + DC = AC. Thus BC + AC = 25, giving AC = 25 - 10 = 15.

推理：题目说明经过 E、D 的线是 AB 的垂直平分线，因此垂直平分线上的点 D 到 A、B 的距离相等，所以 DA = DB。已知三角形 BDC 的周长为 25，所以 BC + BD + DC = 25。把 BD 替换成 DA，得到 BC + DA + DC = 25。由图可见 D 在 AC 上，因此 DA + DC = AC，所以 BC + AC = 25。又 BC = 10，因此 AC = 25 - 10 = 15。
